requirements.title: Execution Policy Core
requirements.description: Implement execution policy backend with default-mode persistence (default mode, auto-fixup, review-agent toggle). Policy is persisted in the unified settings store and applied to new execution runs via the PolicyProvider seam; the legacy GET/PUT /api/v1/execution/policy endpoint and the scheduled-delay field were removed when policy moved into settings.

validation.notes: Execution policy (default mode, auto-fixup, review-agent) is persisted via the settings store and loaded through the policy adapter
Policy default mode is applied to new execution runs when the caller omits a mode

requirements.title: Execution Policy Configuration
requirements.description: Implement configurable policy controls for mode and scheduled delay via CLI

validation.notes: Users can control execution default behavior via CLI
